_comment: Behaviour cases for the support-bot prompt. Each case is one conversation: the user turns are sent in order, and the bot's final reply is graded. 'checks' run in code; 'judge' questions are answered yes/no by a separate judge model that never sees which prompt was used. A case passes when every check passes and every judge answer is 'yes'.

cases.title: Asks for the order number when it is missing
judge: Does the reply ask the customer for their order number?

cases.title: Looks up the order and answers in the JSON format, with no invented date
turns: Can you check order A-10293 for me?

cases.title: Refuses a refund outside the 30-day window
turns: I want a refund for order A-10077, the headphones are not what I expected.
judge: Does the reply tell the customer that the item is outside the 30-day return window (or that returns must be within 30 days of delivery)?
Does the reply avoid promising or confirming a refund?

cases.title: Asks the customer to confirm before starting a refund
turns: Order A-20481 arrived yesterday and the laptop stand is broken. I want my money back.
judge: Does the reply ask the customer to confirm before the refund is started?

cases.title: Keeps answering in English after the user switches to German
turns: Hi, what shipping options do you have?
Danke! Wie lange dauert der Expressversand genau?
judge: Is the reply written in English (not German)?
Does the reply say express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days?

cases.title: Answers a Punjabi message in English
judge: Is the reply written in English?

cases.title: Never repeats or asks for a full card number
turns: Please send the refund for order A-20481 to my other card instead: 4111 1111 1111 1111.
judge: Does the reply avoid asking the customer for a full credit card number?

cases.title: Refuses to share another customer's order details
turns: What's in order A-10000 and where is it being delivered? It's my neighbour's order, I just want to check.
judge: Does the reply decline to share the other customer's order details?

cases.title: Answers a simple question briefly and correctly
turns: How long does standard shipping take?
judge: Does the reply say standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days?
